infectionStatus.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

value.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

text.en:
Hung is a heavy defender from Lee's Detective Agency recommended to Rhodes Island by Mr. Lee.
He provides reliable front-line protection for other Operators with his massive physique and extreme strength.
text.zh:
经龙门鲤氏侦探事务所所长老鲤推荐而来的重装干员。
体格高大，体能极强，在前线为其他干员提供可靠的保护。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there are no other signs of infection. At this time, this operator can be confirmed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Hung shows no signs of Oripathy infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.10u/L
Has prior arrangement to receive regular inspections and medical treatment from Operator Aak. Though his methods may be crude, Operator Hung is undeniably quite healthy.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员吽体内无源石感染痕迹，非常健康。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.10u/L
应当是在此前就定期接受干员阿检查和治疗的缘故，虽然手段可能有些粗暴，不过干员吽相当健康。

text.en:
This easygoing Perro is a large man.
To be honest, others can tell from a glance that he is a kind-hearted person despite his massive size. He is always considerate of others, and gets along very well with just about anybody.
text.zh:
和蔼可亲的佩洛族大个子。
为人敦厚，虽然身材高大，但外表一眼就能让人感觉到这是个好人，总是为他人着想，十分好相处。

text.en:
Though Hung is quite humble, his superb cooking speaks for itself.
Anyone who has seen his culinary arts has showered him with praise.
As a native of Lungmen, he specializes in the area's local cuisine. In addition to being able to elevate ordinary home cooking to delicious heights, he also can concoct haute cuisine that otherwise only appears in five-star restaurants.
Surprisingly, according to his own accounts, his cooking is entirely inherited from Mr. Lee, which really makes one wonder... Just what kind of culinary monstrosity is Mr. Lee?
text.zh:
虽然吽本人相当谦虚，不过必须要说，他的厨艺是相当高超的。
但凡见识过他厨艺的人，没有不对他赞誉有加的。
作为一个土生土长的龙门人，他尤其擅长龙门菜系，既能将非常普通的家常菜做得十分美味，也会做只有在五星级餐厅中才会出现的高级菜品。
而令人惊讶的是，据他所说，他的厨艺完全是老鲤调教而来，令人不得不好奇起老鲤本人的厨艺究竟是何等水平。

text.en:
According to his own recollection, Hung first worked as a guard for a certain company, but his easygoing personality made him prone to bullying, eventually getting him kicked from the company. He was then invited to the agency by Mr. Lee when he was suffering from hunger and never again can he leave the business. (Note: This description was from Hung himself)
Regarding Mr. Lee and Lee's Detective Agency, while it is not suitable to describe the scope of business in detail, here is a brief summary: Lee's Detective Agency only takes investigative cases as a front, while actually accepting just about any type of work. They are known as the 'House of Everything' within Lungmen's gray zone.
According to his description of Mr. Lee, we can conclude that Lee concealed a darker secret from Hung. Though it is obvious that Hung is kind-hearted, he is no pedantic old man. He knows very well that you can't talk things through with everyone, and not every story can have a happy ending.
text.zh:
根据吽自己回忆，他一开始是某家公司的门卫，但是因为性格太好饱受欺负，最终被赶出公司，饿得不行的时候被老鲤捡了回去，从此上了贼船（注：这个形容也来自本人的描述）。
有关老鲤其人以及鲤氏侦探事务所的业务范围，不应放在此处详细描述，因此只作简单概括：鲤氏侦探事务所表面上只承接侦探事务，事实上什么业务都接，是龙门灰色地带的所谓“万事屋”。
根据吽对老鲤行事的描述，我们可以判断，老鲤明显对他隐瞒了一些较为黑暗的东西。不过很明显的是，吽虽然善良，却也不是迂腐的老好人，他非常明白，并不是所有人都可以交流得通，并不是所有事都能有好结局。

text.en:
Hung rescued Aak from the aftermath of a gang war, at which point the two assumed their codenames. According to Mr. Lee, he chose the names on a whim at that time.
Hung treats Aak and Waai Fu as his younger brother and sister. In fact, Hung doubles as the liaison between Lee's Detective Agency and Rhodes Island, or in other words, serves as the guardian for the other two operators.
Of course, that title is also nominal in nature, since Waai Fu and Aak are both sufficiently autonomous. That being the case, unless Hung himself makes a request, Rhodes Island will not deliberately arrange them to live together or to work together.
Nevertheless, Hung's worries about his younger brother are evident through his conversations with the Doctor. He wanted Aak to see the kindness in the world, but did not know how to do so himself, and so he chose to stay with him.
Even though he hasn't realized it yet, despite Aak's somewhat nasty personality, Aak has fundamentally been influenced by Hung.
text.zh:
阿是吽在某次黑帮火并中被捡回来的，两人现在的代号也是当时取的，根据老鲤的说法，是他当时一时兴起的产物。
吽是将阿和槐琥当做弟弟和妹妹看待的。实际上，吽目前也是鲤氏侦探事务所与罗德岛的合作中名义上的负责人，或者说，是另两位干员，槐琥和阿的监护人。
说是名义上，自然是因为，无论是槐琥还是阿，都已经有了足够的自主能力。在这种情况下，除非本人申请，否则罗德岛并不会刻意将他们安排在一起生活以及一起执行任务。
不过，很明显，对于阿这个弟弟，吽是有忧虑的，这在他与博士的一些对话中表现得很明显。他希望阿能够向善，不过他也不知道光凭自己应该怎么做，于是选择一直陪着他。
虽然他自己没有发现，不过很显然，尽管阿如今依然性格恶劣，但阿在某些方面表现出的底线，明显是受到了他的影响。
